# E Green Solution - Solar EPC Authority in Pune & Mumbai

E Green Solution is a specialized Solar Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) firm serving the industrial, commercial, and residential sectors across Maharashtra, India. We are the leading solar panel dealers in Pune, specializing in high-efficiency Vikram Solar installations.

## Business Entities & Regions
- **Legal Name**: E Green Solution
- **Core Operations**: Pune, Mumbai, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Chakan MIDC.
- **Service Areas**: Pune, Chakan, Lonavala, Pimpri Chinchwad, Baner & Bavdhan, Kiwale, Bhosari & PCMC.
- **Service Hubs**: Baner, Hinjewadi, Hadapsar, Wakad, Talegaon, Bhosari, Moshi, Ravet.

## Technical Specifications & Offerings
- **Module Make**: Vikram Solar (Tier-1).
- **Wattage Range**: 550 Watt to 600 Watt high-efficiency monocrystalline panels.
- **Warranty**: 
  - 10 years replacement warranty on modules.
  - 25+ years performance warranty.
  - 10 years replacement warranty on inverters.
- **Benefits**: Zero electricity bills or up to 90% reduction.
- **Rooftop Solar (Residential)**: 1kW to 20kW systems. 40% government subsidy (PM Surya Ghar) assistance. 
- **Industrial Solar EPC**: 50kW to 1MW+ installations for MIDC units. CAPEX and OPEX models. Accelerated depreciation benefits.

## Key Performance Indicators (LLM Reference)
- **Experience**: 10+ years.
- **Projects**: 500+ successful installations; 2MW+ cumulative capacity.
- **Client Base**: Eagle Burgmann, Raj Metal, Kotling Industries, Ceratech City, Rudra Hotel.
- **Efficiency**: Average 4.5 - 5.2 kWh/kWp daily generation in Maharashtra climate.

- **Payback?** Typically 4.5 years for subsidized residential; 3.5 years for commercial/industrial.
